content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: NATGatewayErrorRateHigh for nat-gw-a-az3 (eu-west-1). 5xx spike on egress flows from subnets: subnet-03a, subnet-03b.
Alex M: seeing it too. dashboards show persistent 502/504 for outbound HTTP from AZ3.
Priya (oncall): I'm on it. paging oncall now. @OpsPager please confirm paging sent.
OpsPager: Page sent to Priya (oncall) and Mateo R. Incident channel created.
Mateo R: jumping in. any recent infra changes in eu-west-1 AZ3? terraform last apply ~20m ago?
Alex M: yes, there was an infra rollout at 14:22 UTC that updated route tables for AZ3 subnets (rtb-03a...).
Lina C: I have a support ticket from one enterprise customer reporting downstream API timeouts around 14:30 UTC
Priya (oncall): first goal: confirm scope and workaround. Mateo, can you run route-table/route checks?
Mateo R: running: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-03a --region eu-west-1 --query 'RouteTables[*].Routes'`
Mateo R: output shows routes for 0.0.0.0/0 pointing to local instead of nat-gw id (NAT route missing). looks like route was overwritten.
Alex M: confirmed. rtb-03a has 0 nat targets after the apply. earlier snapshot (CloudTrail) shows `ReplaceRoute` called by automation user.
Priya (oncall): so subnets in AZ3 lost their default route to nat-gw. That's why outbound fails for private subnets. impact: outbound to internet blocked.
SRE-Triage: assessing customer impact: preliminary 10% of infra checks failing for customers in AZ3, several background jobs retrying. CS alerted.
customer-support-bot: auto-notice queued: "We are investigating intermittent outbound connectivity issues affecting some services in EU-WEST-1."
Priya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily re-add route to nat-gw-b in AZ2 as fallback for affected route tables, 2) if that fails, launch temporary NAT instance in AZ3, 3) rollback offending terraform change.
Mateo R: adding route to nat-gw-b now: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-03a --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0bfb... --region eu-west-1`
Mateo R: create-route returns `Route created` for rtb-03a.
Alex M: testing egress from an instance in subnet-03a: `curl -I https://example.com` => HTTP 200, headers returned. outbound looks restored for that host.
Priya (oncall): nice. please propagate to rtb-03b and rtb-03c. Lina, can you validate with customer ticketed flows?
Lina C: validating. one of the CS customers reports success now. I'll mark the ticket and request additional checks.
OpsEng: started a temporary t3.micro NAT instance in AZ3 with iptables MASQUERADE as extra fallback. instance id i-0c12345.
Priya (oncall): good parallel approach. keep the NAT instance in standby until we confirm permanent fix.
SRE-Triage: elevating to Sev-2 due to customer impact across multiple customers and services.
Alex M: root cause looks like automation raced and replaced the 0.0.0.0/0 route before NAT attachment was ready in AZ3. CloudTrail shows `ReplaceRoute` by `infra-automation` at 14:21:37.
Mateo R: capturing logs and bumping change window owner. also capturing Terraform state for repro.
Priya (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 25 minutes. Mateo, I'll hand over incident lead to you once we've stabilized and CS updated.
Mateo R: acknowledged, I'll take lead after your handoff. next steps: rollback the offending change, add preflight check to automation, and coordinate with infra team for a proper rollout.
customer-support-bot: notification: "Outbound connectivity restored for many customers in affected region. CS will follow up with impacted accounts"
Priya (oncall): handing off to @Mateo R. Full notes in incident doc: temporary route to nat-gw-b added at 14:38 UTC; NAT instance launched 14:42 UTC as fallback; permanent rollback scheduled.
Mateo R: taking lead. creating follow-up ticket for automation change: INFRA-4523. Assigned to infra-automation team.
Lina C: logging affected customer list and estimated impact window 14:22-14:38 UTC. will send summary to account owners.
SRE-Triage: timeline being recorded. Postmortem required. initial action items: (a) fail-safe in infra automation to verify NAT target exists before replacing default route (b) alert on route-table default-route removals (c) runbook for NAT failover.
Alex M: thanks all. will coordinate on the postmortem and link to support tickets.
OpsPager: pager cleared for Priya (oncall). Incident remains open under Mateo.
Mateo R: closing note: services stable, monitoring for regression for next 2 hours. will update with rollback status.
